svg.text: One weight before tuning (0.0213) and after (+0.0009), stored three ways
the change survives, one step apart
both round to the same value: the change is gone
Illustration. Grids use one scale per block set by its largest weight, 0.08.
q4_k_m's real grid is finer than plain 4-bit; the direction of the effect is the same.
